sharedGatewayRules.stepUpRule: No route in PER-013 or TIM-017 receives stepUpCommandBindings. Atomic duties mark step_up_required=N. SYS-001 retains STEPUP-MGMT-HIGH-V1 on its capability but its two ELEVATED-only GET projections have no command binding under the exact allowlisted read exception below. This does not remove the Gateway expected-decision-revision check or owner If-Match CAS.
sharedGatewayRules.timeOperatorCompatibility: The TIM correction operator profile must use CAPABILITY_EXPRESSION/ANY with the single hcm.operations.time.update key, matching the existing non-step-up Time interpretation pattern; it must not silently introduce a step-up binding contrary to the duty matrix.

sysSharedV42Participant.scopeRule: SYS-001 contributes only its sealed authorization, OpenAPI, Gateway, Platform owner-PEP, closed projection, and targeted test delta to the shared v42 cycle. Its feature implementation and activation remain independently controlled.

newPredicates.rule: Require TENANT identity provenance, ELEVATED active access, APP.HCM:VIEW, ADMIN.AUDIT_VIEW:VIEW, HRIS_AUDITOR, exact HRIS_DUTY_AUDITOR responsibility at APP.HCM/RS_HCM_CONFIG, current field and authorization revisions, fixed product=HCM binding, HRIS_AUDIT_EVIDENCE purpose, and a passing SOD_HRIS_AUDIT_INDEPENDENCE decision; deny provider, delegated, support, cross-tenant, or ambiguous-scope evidence.

allRequiredConditions: route kind is PAGE or DATA
every gateway and service binding method is GET

readTimeStepUpGeneratorRule.effect: Permit stepUpCommandBindings to be absent only for the two exact SYS read routes. NORMAL access may receive the existing elevation challenge but can never receive evidence. Every other step-up route retains the command-binding requirement.

authChallengeOnlyRule.normalMode: The Auth authority adapter may evaluate the sole ELEVATED read profile only as a challenge candidate after full entitlement, permission, package, responsibility, product-root scope, predicate, and 28-conflict SoD checks. Its only non-denial result is STEP_UP_REQUIRED; it must never return ALLOWED or produce owner-forwarding evidence.
authChallengeOnlyRule.elevatedMode: The same exact profile is evaluated normally and may be allowed only after every sealed authority condition passes.
authChallengeOnlyRule.nearMisses: A different route key, route kind, method, access-mode set, capability, activation policy, predicate, target binding, projection, response schema, query constraint, purpose, field group, or readOnly value uses the existing default evaluation and topology rules.

properties.writable: boolean derived after current assignment/state/purpose re-evaluation
properties.draftContentHash: lowercase sha256, including the deterministic empty draft

properties.items: ordered ReviewFormItemV1 array; sequence is contiguous from one within the published template projection

ReviewFormV1.labelRule: Resolve label and helpText for the requested locale at the owner; do not expose unrestricted i18n JSON.
ReviewFormV1.visibilityRule: visibility_policy and scoring_policy remain owner evidence and hash inputs; only field-policy-permitted form elements are serialized.

ReviewDraftCommandV1.answers: 1..500 typed TEXT|DECIMAL|RATING|CHOICE answers, unique by itemKey; decimal/rating values are canonical decimal strings with at most six fractional digits

hashContract.canonicalEncoding: UTF-8 JSON, object keys sorted lexicographically at every depth, arrays in the sealed order below, no insignificant whitespace, UUID and enum text preserved, decimals serialized as canonical strings, null serialized only where the schema permits it

input: items ordered by sequence then itemKey
rubric levels ordered by scaleKey then sequence then levelKey
templateContentHash.immutability: The hash is copied from the immutable published template version and persisted on every draft snapshot and final submission.

draftContentHash.answerOrder: itemKey ascending; duplicate itemKey is invalid
draftContentHash.emptyDraft: answers=[] is hashed and returned on the initial GET
draftContentHash.saveRule: PATCH recomputes and returns the persisted draftContentHash after CAS.
draftContentHash.submitRule: Submit requires body draftContentHash equal to the latest persisted draft hash and If-Match equal to aggregateVersion; either mismatch is 409 with no state, receipt, submission, or outbox side effect.

event.deliveryRule: One stable event UUID is inserted in the same transaction as the immutable submission. Exact idempotent replay returns the original result and emits no second event.

v10LedgerAmendmentInsideV11.rule: V10 is immutable migration history. V11 alters the resulting schema forward; V10 is never edited or copied.
requiredAlterations: ALTER interpretation_attempt_public_id to nullable; retain its tenant-scoped foreign key for non-null values.
Replace the source/reversal consistency check with the three exact source profiles below.
Replace the reversal quantity rule and add a trigger that proves a reversal quantity is the exact negation of the referenced effective entry and cannot reverse an already reversed row.
Keep all ledger rows append-only and keep tenant+worker+ledger_revision unique.

sourceProfiles.INTERPRETATION: interpretation_attempt_public_id is non-null; reverses_entry_public_id and reason_code are null; source_public_id is the interpretation attempt public ID; quantity is >= 0.
sourceProfiles.MANUAL_CORRECTION: interpretation_attempt_public_id and reverses_entry_public_id are null; reason_code is a bounded nonblank correction code; source_public_id is correctionId; quantity is nonzero.
sourceProfiles.REVERSAL: reverses_entry_public_id is non-null; reason_code is CLOCK_INPUT_REINTERPRETED or TIMECARD_CORRECTION; source_public_id is the initiating interpretation attempt or correctionId; quantity exactly negates the referenced entry.

digestRules.reversalInputDigest: digest of initiating command plus referenced ledger public ID
digestRules.reversalRuleDigest: same correction/reinterpretation policy digest used to authorize the reversal
